summary: Restored the Invalid and MultipleInvalid attribute surface in voluptuous/error.py (path, msg, error_message properties, prepend, add, and delegating properties on MultipleInvalid) so the existing _path and _error_message storage is exposed as the public attributes the rest of the package and tests use. The last full-suite run I saw passed all 148 tests (tests.py was the only failing file, 89 failures, now claimed and fixed).
